stem: A child with chronic diarrhoea and poor growth has duodenal villous atrophy on biopsy. Which diagnosis is most likely?
explanation: Duodenal villous atrophy with compatible symptoms is most consistent with coeliac disease, especially when supported by coeliac serology or IgA-adjusted testing.
